question: Two charges $q$ and $-q$ are kept apart. Then at any point on the perpendicular bisector of the line joining the two charges

options.text: the electric field strength is zero
both electric potential and electric field strength are zero
both electric potential and electric field strength are non-zero

solution:
Every point on the perpendicular bisector is equidistant from the two charges, so their potentials $\dfrac{kq}{r}$ and $-\dfrac{kq}{r}$ cancel: $V = 0$.

The fields do not cancel: their components along the bisector cancel, but the components parallel to the dipole axis add. So $E \neq 0$.
